A <br> inside a fenced code block stays a real newline, not a split span

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<pre><code>A<br>B</code></pre>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
